60348-professor-w-g-elmslie-d-d-memoir-a.title: Professor W G Elmslie D D Memoir And Sermons
60348-professor-w-g-elmslie-d-d-memoir-a.creator: Unknown
60348-professor-w-g-elmslie-d-d-memoir-a.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. cases where I have had the benefit of short-hand reports I have, with the slightest alteration, printed the sermons as they were delivered. Two "Sunday Readings" are reprinted from _Good Words_, and an article on Genesis from the _Contemporary Review_.

arxiv-1906-02678.title: IoT-Enabled Distributed Data Processing for Precision Agriculture
arxiv-1906-02678.creator: Grigore Stamatescu, Cristian Drăgana, Iulia Stamatescu, Loretta Ichim, Dan Popescu
arxiv-1906-02678.description: Abstract Large scale monitoring systems, enabled by the emergence of networked embedded sensing devices, offer the opportunity of fine grained online spatio-temporal collection, communication and analysis of physical parameters. Various applications have been proposed and validated so far for environmental monitoring, security and industrial control systems.

arxiv-2204-00265.title: Copula-based statistical dependence visualizations
arxiv-2204-00265.creator: Arturo Erdely and Manuel Rubio-Sánchez
arxiv-2204-00265.description: Abstract A frequent task in exploratory data analysis consists in examining pairwise dependencies between data variables. Popular approaches include visualizing correlation or scatter plot matrices. However, both methods can be misleading. The former is primarily limited because it reports a single value for a pair of random variables.

arxiv-2206-08054.title: Generalized Leverage Scores: Geometric Interpretation and Applications
arxiv-2206-08054.creator: Bruno Ordozgoiti, Antonis Matakos, Aristides Gionis
arxiv-2206-08054.description: Abstract In problems involving matrix computations, the concept of leverage has found a large number of applications. In particular, leverage scores , which relate the columns of a matrix to the subspaces spanned by its leading singular vectors, are helpful in revealing column subsets to approximately factorize a matrix with quality guarantees.

arxiv-2207-01108.title: On Streaming Algorithms for Geometric Independent Set and Clique
arxiv-2207-01108.creator: Sujoy Bhore ID, Fabian Klute ID, Jelle J. Oostveen
arxiv-2207-01108.description: Abstract We study the maximum geometric independent set and clique problems in the streaming model. Given a collection of geometric objects arriving in an insertion only stream, the aim is to find a subset such that all objects in the subset are pairwise disjoint or intersect respectively.

arxiv-2305-12143.title: Learning Horn Envelopes via Queries from Language Models
arxiv-2305-12143.creator: Sophie Blum, Raoul Koudijs, Ana Ozaki, Samia Touileb, University of Bergen & University of Oslo
arxiv-2305-12143.description: Abstract We present an approach for systematically probing a trained neural network to extract a symbolic abstraction of it, represented as a Boolean formula. We formulate this task within Angluin’s exact learning framework, where a learner attempts to extract information from an oracle (in our work, the neural network) by posing membership and equivalence queries.

arxiv-2404-00713.title: Computing Proximity Operators of Scale and Signed Permutation Invariant Functions
arxiv-2404-00713.creator: Jianqing Jia, Ashley Prater-Bennette, Lixin Shen
arxiv-2404-00713.description: Abstract This paper investigates the computation of proximity operators for scale and signed permutation invariant functions. A scale-invariant function remains unchanged under uniform scaling, while a signed permutation invariant function retains its structure despite permutations and sign changes applied to its input variables.

arxiv-2407-03030.title: An isometric extensor of metrics
arxiv-2407-03030.creator: Yoshito Ishiki
arxiv-2407-03030.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yoshito Ishiki. In this paper, for a metrizable space Z Z , we consider the space of metrics that generate the same topology on Z Z , and that space of metrics is equipped with the supremum metrics.

arxiv-2509-00115.title: Adaptive Monitoring and Real‑World Evaluation of Agentic AI Systems
arxiv-2509-00115.creator: Manish A. Shukla
arxiv-2509-00115.description: Abstract Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) — multi‑agent systems that combine large language models with external tools and autonomous planning — are rapidly transitioning from research laboratories into high‑stakes domains. Our earlier “Basic” paper introduced a five‑axis framework and proposed preliminary metrics such as goal drift and harm reduction but did not provide an algorithmic instantiation or empirical evidence.

arxiv-2509-05273.title: Greener Deep Reinforcement Learning: Analysis of Energy and Carbon Efficiency Across Atari Benchmarks Thanks: This work is supported in part by NSF CPS Grants #1932300 and #1931767.
arxiv-2509-05273.creator: Jason Gardner 1 , Ayan Dutta 1 , Swapnoneel Roy 1 , O. Patrick Kreidl 1 and Ladislau Bölöni 2
arxiv-2509-05273.description: Abstract The growing computational demands of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) have raised concerns about the environmental and economic costs of training large-scale models. While algorithmic efficiency in terms of learning performance has been extensively studied, the energy requirements, greenhouse gas emissions, and monetary costs of DRL algorithms remain largely unexplored.

arxiv-2511-13439.title: Characterizing Transfer Systems for Non-Abelian Groups
arxiv-2511-13439.creator: Sarah Klanderman, Chloe Lewis, Harlea Monson, Koki Shibata, Danika Van Niel
arxiv-2511-13439.description: Abstract . For a finite group G G , the notion of a G G -transfer system provides homotopy theorists with a combinatorial way to study equivariant objects. In this paper, we focus on the properties of transfer systems for non-abelian groups. We explicitly describe the width of all dihedral groups, quaternion groups, and dicyclic groups.

arxiv-2602-06715.title: Practical Refinement Session Type Inference (Extended Version)
arxiv-2602-06715.creator: Toby Ueno, Ankush Das
arxiv-2602-06715.description: Abstract Session types express and enforce safe communication in concurrent message-passing systems by statically capturing the interaction protocols between processes in the type. Recent works extend session types with arithmetic refinements, which enable additional fine-grained description of communication, but impose additional annotation burden on the programmer.

arxiv-2606-27246.title: Effective Covariance Dynamics in Solvable High-Dimensional GANs
arxiv-2606-27246.creator: Andrew Bond, Zafer Doğan

europmc-pmc8228195.creator: Šimić G, Tkalčić M, Vukić V, Mulc D, Španić E, Šagud M, Olucha-Bordonau FE, Vukšić M, R Hof P.
europmc-pmc8228195.description: Emotions arise from activations of specialized neuronal populations in several parts of the cerebral cortex, notably the anterior cingulate, insula, ventromedial prefrontal, and subcortical structures, such as the amygdala, ventral striatum, putamen, caudate nucleus, and ventral

openalex-w2290369781.title: Envirotyping for deciphering environmental impacts on crop plants
openalex-w2290369781.creator: Yunbi Xu
openalex-w2290369781.description: Global climate change imposes increasing impacts on our environments and crop production. To decipher environmental impacts on crop plants, the concept "envirotyping" is proposed, as a third "typing" technology, complementing with genotyping and phenotyping. Environmental...

pmc-10651515.title: A2LiGaI6 (A = Cs, Rb): New lead-free and direct bandgap halide double perovskites for IR application
pmc-10651515.creator: Anwar ul Haq, Tasawer Shahzad Ahmad, Afaq Ahmad, Badriah S. Almutairi, Muhammad Amin, M.I. Khan, Nimra Ehsan, Ramesh Sharma
pmc-10651515.description: Recently, all inorganic double perovskites have drawn a lot of interest as promising solar materials. The optical, structural, thermoelectric, electronic, and mechanical properties of double halide perovskites A2LiGaI6 (A = Cs, Rb) are explored via first-principles calculations with the WIEN2k code, using GGA PBEsol and TB-mBJ potentials.

pmc-11295499.title: The influence of exercise intensity on comorbid anxious behavior in psychiatric conditions
pmc-11295499.creator: Dong-Joo Hwang, Tae-Kyung Kim
pmc-11295499.description: Many experts have extensively studied the potential of exercise as a treatment option for psychiatric conditions, including depression and autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Despite their core symptoms, these conditions exhibits comparable component traits, an anxiety. In this study, we explored the effect of exercise on behavioral abnormalities in psychiatric conditions, focusing on its intensity and emotional resilience.

pmc-11342584.title: Meta-analysis of robotic-assisted NOSE versus traditional TWSR in colorectal cancer surgery: postoperative outcomes and efficacy
pmc-11342584.creator: Shixiong Zhan, Zhicheng Zhu, Haitao Yu, Yu Xia, Tian Xu, Zhenda Wan
pmc-11342584.description: BackgroundThis meta-analysis aimed to assess the safety and efficacy of robotic-assisted natural orifice specimen extraction surgery (NOSE) compared to traditional robotic transabdominal wall specimen retrieval surgery (TWSR) for colorectal cancer.MethodsA systematic search was conducted in three electronic databases (PubMed, Web of Science and Embase) from inception to August 2023.

pmc-11417143.title: Isolated large demyelinated plaque with clinical and radiologic appearance suggestive of cervical intramedullary tumor diagnosed after surgery
pmc-11417143.creator: Taha Eser, Askin Esen Hasturk
pmc-11417143.description: Isolated spinal demyelinating lesions are rare and often associated with multiple sclerosis. While initial radiological findings may suggest a tumor, a definitive diagnosis requires a histological diagnosis. A 45-year-old woman presented with progressive spastic tetraparesis for 1 week. She had no prior history of neurological or systemic illness.

pmc-11523763.title: Accelerating Evidence Synthesis in Observational Studies: Development of a Living Natural Language Processing–Assisted Intelligent Systematic Literature Review System
pmc-11523763.creator: Frank J Manion, Jingcheng Du, Dong Wang, Long He, Bin Lin, Jingqi Wang, Siwei Wang, David Eckels, Jan Cervenka, Peter C Fiduccia, Nicole Cossrow, Lixia Yao, Caroline Perrin
pmc-11523763.description: BackgroundSystematic literature review (SLR), a robust method to identify and summarize evidence from published sources, is considered to be a complex, time-consuming, labor-intensive, and expensive task.ObjectiveThis study aimed to present a solution based on natural language processing (NLP) that accelerates and streamlines the SLR process for observational studies using real-world data.

pmc-11545208.title: Unveiling GATOR2 Function: Novel Insights from Drosophila Research
pmc-11545208.creator: Lucia Bettedi, Yingbiao Zhang, Shu Yang, Mary A Lilly, Bor Luen Tang, Cord Brakebusch
pmc-11545208.description: The multiprotein Target of Rapamycin (TOR) Complex 1 (TORC1) is a serine/threonine kinase that stimulates anabolic metabolism and suppresses catabolism. Deregulation of TORC1 is implicated in various human pathologies, including cancer, epilepsy, and neurodegenerative disorders. The Gap Activity Towards Rags (GATOR) complex contains two subcomplexes: GATOR1, which inhibits TORC1 activity; and GATOR2, which counteracts GATOR1s function.

pmc-11546919.title: Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement: Latest Advances and Prospects
pmc-11546919.creator: Lluis Asmarats, Dabit Arzamendi
pmc-11546919.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). s across the surgical risk spectrum [1]. Since the first-in-man case in 2002 [2], continuous device iterations, increased operator experience, and procedure simplification have led to a dramatic reduction in procedural complications and steady improvement in clinical outcomes [3]. However, despite these improvements, complications still occur in a non-negligible proportion of patients in contemporary practice and may adversely affect clinical outcomes.

pmc-11555186.title: Unlocking the potential of immunotherapy in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer: rationale, challenges, and novel strategies
pmc-11555186.creator: Joanna Kefas, Michael Flynn
pmc-11555186.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Ovarian cancer is a significant global health challenge, with cytoreductive surgery and platinum-based chemotherapy serving as established primary treatments. Unfortunately, most patients relapse and ultimately become platinum-resistant, at which point there are limited effective treatment options. Given the success of immunotherapy in inducing durable treatment responses in several other cancers, its potential in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer (PROC) is currently being investigated.

pmc-11628190.title: High recent PrEP adherence with point‐of‐care urine tenofovir testing and adherence counselling among young African women: results from the INSIGHT cohort
pmc-11628190.creator: Brenda Gati Mirembe, Deborah Donnell, Meighan Krows, Zinhle Zwane, Elizabeth Bukusi, Ravindre Panchia, Cheryl Louw, Noluthando Mwelase, Pearl Selepe, Melissa Senne, Logashvari Naidoo, Rachel Chihana, Margaret Kasaro, Harriet Nuwagaba‐Biribonwoha, Philip Kotze, Katherine Gill, Pippa MacDonald, Alasta
pmc-11628190.description: IntroductionAdolescent girls and young women (AGYW) account for two‐thirds of new HIV infections in Africa. African AGYW have had high uptake of oral HIV pre‐exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) but low adherence, which might be improved by point‐of‐care adherence monitoring with tailored counselling.

pmc-12820263.title: Prognostic outcome of extranodal marginal zone B-cell lymphoma: a nationwide cohort
pmc-12820263.creator: Su Youn Nam, Junwoo Jo
pmc-12820263.description: We aimed to investigate prognostic determinants of extranodal marginal zone B-cell lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT lymphoma). We analyzed 11,730 patients captured in the National cancer registry. Kaplan–Meier estimates compared survival by sex, age, and SEER stage, while multivariable Cox models identified mortality determinants. Women represented 54.6% of cases and had better survival than men.

pmc-13507899.title: Correction to: N-back task revisited: Comparing the neural correlates of updating and interference control
pmc-13507899.creator: Esmeralda Hidalgo-Lopez, Isabel Noachtar, Belinda Angela Pletzer
pmc-13507899.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). numerical values reported in Table 2, as well as some numerical values in the text. pmc-13571942.title: Development of a 3D-bioprinted tumour-on-chip with tunable hydrogel properties for monitoring colorectal cancer cell migration and invasion
pmc-13571942.creator: Adrian García, Lia Jove, María Pereira, Angelica Figueroa, Daniel Nieto
pmc-13571942.description: Understanding the mechanisms governing cancer cell migration is essential for elucidating the early events of colorectal cancer metastasis. Here, we report the development of a light-tunable three-dimensional (3D) bioprinted tumour-on-chip platform for monitoring the migration of colorectal cancer cells under biomimetic microenvironmental conditions.

pmc-13580173.title: Sequential Regulation of Neurovascular Bone Regeneration in Large Bone Defects Using Black Phosphorus‐Europium Nanosheet Integrated TPMS Biomimetic Scaffold with Photo‐Controlled Ion Release
pmc-13580173.creator: Bingqian Wang, Yuping Zhang, Xiaoning Su, Ning Liu, Hui Zeng, Bo Yang, Yang Xue, Fang Guo, Changkui Liu
pmc-13580173.description: Titanium alloy scaffolds (Ti–6Al–4 V) are widely used to repair bone defects. However, conventional titanium‐based implants lack customized functional surface interfaces that promote coordinated local nerve and blood vessel regeneration, thereby limiting bone regeneration and long‐term stability. To address this limitation, we utilize a topologically optimized triple‐periodic minimal surface (TPMS) porous titanium (Ti) scaffold.

uslaw-usc-t16-s1015.title: 16 U.S.C. § 1015 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t16-s1015.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s1015.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 18A (Cooperative Watershed Management Program). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this chapter: (1) Affected stakeholder The term “affected stakeholder” means an entity that significantly affects, or is significantly affected by, the quality or quantity of water in a watershed, as determined by the Secretary. (2) Disadvantaged community The term “disadvantaged community” means a community.
